stories.title: DTC STOP-tier SAFETY treatment -- repoint off brand-red + Spool §6d multi-channel (color+area+motion+text+bg+brightness)
acceptance: PREREQ: --critical-red #D32F2F added to specs/UI/tokens.css (Spool assigned the value 2026-07-25; Atlas owes the one-line token gate -- routed). Repoint against the token, not a hardcoded hex.
repoint the DTC STOP tier + takeover OFF brand --red-light #F61D2D onto --critical-red #D32F2F (dashboard.css #dtc-ribbon[data-level=stop], .dtc-chip[stop], .dtc-hero[stop], #confirm-ok)

Spool §6d ch.1 -- AREA+MOTION+TEXT carry STOP: STOP takeover is full-bleed/large-area + pulsing motion + explicit 'PULL OVER' text; the brand mark stays small + static. (color is the 3rd reinforcement, not the 1st)
Spool §6d ch.2 -- STOP red renders on NEAR-BLACK (#000/#0a0a0a) with WHITE copy, never on brand chrome; text contrast >= WCAG-AA large-text
Spool §6d ch.3 -- deeper-and-darker axis only; NO warmer/orange shift (would collide with amber WATCH #FFC400 and invert severity order). WATCH stays #FFC400, MINOR stays #35C46A -- unchanged
Spool §6d ch.4 -- a STOP alarm is FULL BRIGHTNESS ALWAYS, independent of the US-483-b auto-dim (only ambient content dims; ties to the alarmFloorLevel guard -- STOP overrides even the floor to full)
grep confirms the STOP tier no longer references brand --red-light; UI/pi tests green incl. a test that STOP renders full-bleed + full-brightness on near-black

validationCriteria.action: trigger a STOP-tier DTC takeover on the Pi
validationCriteria.outcome: renders full-bleed on near-black, white 'PULL OVER' text, pulsing, in --critical-red #D32F2F (not brand --red-light); brand mark small+static

validationCriteria.action: trigger STOP while auto-dim says dark
validationCriteria.outcome: STOP stays full brightness (not dimmed) -- ch.4 satisfied

validationCriteria.action: compare STOP vs WATCH vs MINOR
validationCriteria.outcome: severity order reads correctly by area/motion/text; no orange collision between STOP and amber WATCH

conditionalOutcomes: if --critical-red is not yet in tokens.css at build time, STOP + ping PM/Atlas for the one-line gate (value is decided #D32F2F; do NOT hardcode the hex or pick your own)
the pulsing-motion treatment must respect the 'motion never implies a state that isn't real' rule (carousel spec §4) -- pulse ONLY on a live STOP, never decoratively
stories.goal: As engine-safety signal integrity, I want the DTC STOP/'PULL OVER' tier + takeover to stop rendering in BRAND red --red-light #F61D2D (the brand-vs-alarm collision) and instead carry the STOP signal by Spool's full multi-channel treatment. Per Spool 2026-07-25 (offices/tuner/dtc-display-clear-safety-advisory.md §6d): the hex alone is INSUFFICIENT -- #D32F2F vs brand red differ mainly in saturation (weakest discriminator, worse on the narrow-gamut OSOYOO panel). Area+motion+text carry STOP; color is the third reinforcement. (Split from US-484; the safety half.)
